item.title: ezkfg v0.1.1 Release: Configuration Loading and Saving Updates
item.description: Records the updates for the Python configuration tool ezkfg v0.1.1, introducing changes to the configuration loading interface, comparison behavior, and save functionality, along with a link to version differences.

item.title: ezkfg: Design and Implementation of a Python Configuration Tool
item.description: Introduces the design and implementation of the Python configuration tool ezkfg, compares usage methods of argparse, configuration classes, and configuration files, and outlines project requirements and future plans.
